people.name: Adullam
people.line: A Canaanite city, later fortified by Judah.

translations.web: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
translations.bsb: About that time, Judah left his brothers and settled near a man named Hirah, an Adullamite.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass at that time, that Judah went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
